itemListElement.name: A 1,650 lb gun safe, delivered and installed in a Moorefield basement

acceptedAnswer.text: This one is 1,650 lb as the owner states it — inside the 1,500 to 3,500 lb band our SIR method is built for (1, 2). Yes, a safe that heavy can go into a basement: the route is surveyed first, the floor is checked with reference to L/360, and placement is verified at the end. This Moorefield safe went in at basement level through double doors and was placed in an unfinished basement (3).

mainEntity.name: How much does a Winchester Big Daddy XLT2 weigh, and can a safe that heavy go into a basement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — the safe is emptied first, always, before move day; everything comes out (1, 2). Loose contents shift in transit and add weight the plan did not count, so an emptied safe is part of how the flat rate is set. What comes out travels separately, following applicable law (2).

mainEntity.name: Do I have to empty my gun safe before you move it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Equipment is matched to the project — there is no single standard rig (1, 2). On this job the ground made the choice: gravel will not carry small hard wheels, so the safe crossed it on a six-wheel all-terrain dolly, wrapped in a moving blanket under shrink wrap, and the same dolly took it through the doors and along the basement path (3). On a different surface or a staircase, the plan names different equipment.

mainEntity.name: What equipment moves a 1,650 lb safe across gravel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Re-anchoring at the destination is available on request (1, 2). Tell us at quote time whether the safe is bolted down where it sits now, and whether you want it anchored where it lands, so both ends are in the plan before move day. Anchoring method follows the floor — concrete and wood subfloors take different hardware (2).

mainEntity.name: Can you anchor the safe once it is placed?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no posted per-job price, because no two safe moves carry the same route. Every job is reviewed in full — the safe, its weight, the ground, the doors, the path — and priced at one flat rate in writing before move day, never hourly (1, 2). Send the make, model or approximate weight and a film-only video walkthrough of the path, and the estimate is made by a person from the real route (1).

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to have a gun safe delivered and installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Moorefield and Hardy County are in the published service areas of both of our branches — The Flat Rate Movers in Winchester, VA and Flat Rate Movers Martinsburg WV — inside the company's 53-area footprint (1, 2). Rural access is normal work in this footprint: gravel approaches, basement placements, and long final-mile runs are planned the same way this job was (3).
